# Beaches Notary & Apostille Service
Trusted provider of mobile notary, fingerprinting, FBI background checks, apostille processing, translation, and document preparation services. Based in West Palm Beach, serving clients nationwide.

- URL: https://www.beachesnotaryservice.com
- Audience: Individuals, families, businesses, HR teams, immigration attorneys, adoption agencies, and international clients.
- Language: English
- Last updated: 2026-08-03

## Core Services and Pricing

### All-in-One Live Scan Fingerprinting / FBI Background Check / Apostille (Nationwide)
- Starting price: $325
- Timeframe: 24–72 hours for background check; 10 business days for apostille; 2 business days for return shipping
- Description: Fastest apostille for your FBI background check, serving clients nationwide.

### Apostille Service (Florida & Federal)
- Starting price: $199
- Timeframe: 3–5 business days for Florida; 10 business days for Federal
- Description: Authentication and apostilles of all Florida documents, FBI background checks, certificates of naturalization, and other federal documents for international use. Apostille service also available for all 50 states.

### Mobile Notary Services
- Starting price: $100 Travel Fee plus $10 for each signature notarized
- Timeframe: Same-day available or scheduled appointments
- Description: Mobile notarization for personal and business general document notarization.

### Remote Online Notary Service
-Starting price: $55
-Timeframe: 15 minutes
-Description: Notarize your documents online from anywhere.  Serving Nationwide and international clients

### Certified Translation
- Starting price: $60 per page (225 words max per page)
- Timeframe: 24–48 hours
- Description: USCIS-compliant translations for immigration, legal, academic, and international documents.

### Florida Lady Bird Deed and Florida Quit Claim Document Preparation
- Starting price: $150
- Timeframe: 3 business days
- Description: Non-lawyer document preparation service using Florida statewide approved forms.

### Estate Planning Document Notarization
-Starting price: $250 flat fee
-Timeframe: Same-day or scheduled
-Description: Mobile Notarize for estate planning packages that include: wills, powers of attorney, and healthcare directives. Witnesses available at $50 each.

### Real Estate Closing Notary
-Starting price: $150
-Timeframe: Scheduled
-Description: Mobile notary services for loan signings, refinance packages, HELOCs, seller documents, and buyer documents.  
-Notary‑provided witnesses available: $50 each.

### Expedited Business Document Apostille
-Starting price: $299
-Timeframe: 3-5 business days (Florida)
-Description: Apostilles for corporate documents including Articles of Incorporation, Certificates of Status, bylaws, operating agreements, and commercial contracts.  
-Document retrieval: From $10

### Apostille for Vital Records
-Starting price: $199
-Timeframe: 3-5 business days, and 30-45 days (Florida)
-Description: Apostille processing for birth certificates, marriage certificates, death certificates, and divorce decrees issued in Florida.  

### I-9 Employment Verification Service
-Starting price: $75 Plus a Travel fee
-Timeframe: Same-day appointments available or scheduled
-Description: Authorized employer representative for remote hires. Includes identity verification, Section 2 completion, and secure document handling for HR teams and nationwide employers.
